key_features: DURABLE - Crafted from cold-rolled steel with a protective black powder coating, the 15U NavePoint Performance Series network cabinet provides sturdy, reliable housing for network and server equipment. Capable of supporting up to 130 lbs, it's an ideal, durable solution for installers working on long-term projects.

VERSATILE & SPACE EFFICIENT - This 15U server cabinet, designed for 19" IT and A/V equipment installations, offers maximum versatility. With its ability to be free-standing or wall-mounted, it can adapt to various installation needs. The data cabinet also includes casters for easy mobility, which add 3 inches to the total height. With dimensions of 23.63"L x 23.63"W x 31"H and a depth of 600mm, this cabinet provides 15U of rack space, accommodating servers and switches of different depths.

USER-FRIENDLY CUSTOMIZATION – Features like removable, locking side panels and an L-shaped spring pin for easy door direction changes enhance user-friendliness. The IT cabinet arrives flat-packed, includes all necessary hardware for assembly, and supports user-friendly customization to suit individual requirements.

ENHANCED VENTILATION & SECURITY - Built-in fans and flow-through ventilation work to prevent overheating, ensuring optimal operation of your equipment. The reinforced, lockable tempered glass front door not only boosts security but also facilitates easy monitoring of installed equipment.
SAFETY & COMPLIANCE - All NavePoint products are built to industry standards.
